import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0 (2015 data)
    # Columns: ['Country', 'Region', 'Happiness Rank', 'Happiness Score', 'Standard Error',
    #           'Economy (GDP per Capita)', 'Family', 'Health (Life Expectancy)', 'Freedom',
    #           'Trust (Government Corruption)', 'Generosity', 'Dystopia Residual']
    df_2015 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

    # Rename columns to match target schema suffix _15
    df_2015_renamed = df_2015.rename(columns={
        'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
        'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
        'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
        'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
        'Family': 'Family_15',
        'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
        'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
        'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
        'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
        'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
    })

    # Select only needed columns for target from source0
    df_2015_final = df_2015_renamed[[
        'Country', 'Region', 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
        'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15',
        'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15'
    ]]

    # Load Source 1 (2017 data)
    # Columns: ['Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    #           'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
    #           'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17']
    df_2017 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

    # No renaming needed as columns already match target suffix _17

    # Select only needed columns for target from source1
    df_2017_final = df_2017[[
        'Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
        'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
        'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
    ]]

    # Join the two datasets on 'Country'
    # We use an inner join to keep only countries present in both datasets
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_2015_final, df_2017_final, on='Country', how='inner')

    # After join, 'Region' is only from 2015 data, so it is preserved

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    target_columns = [
        'Country', 'Region',
        'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
        'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
        'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
        'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
        'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
    ]

    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

    # Ensure correct dtypes according to target schema
    # Target schema types:
    # Country: string
    # Region: string
    # Happiness_Rank_15: int
    # Happiness_Score_15: float
    # Standard_Error_15: float
    # Economy_15: float
    # Family_15: float
    # Life_Expectancy_15: float
    # Freedom_15: float
    # Trust_15: float
    # Generosity_15: float
    # Dystopia_15: float
    # Happiness_Rank_17: int
    # Happiness_Score_17: float
    # Whisker_High_17: float
    # Whisker_Low_17: float
    # Economy_17: float
    # Family_17: float
    # Life_Expectancy_17: float
    # Freedom_17: float
    # Generosity_17: float
    # Trust_17: float
    # Dystopia_17: float

    # Convert dtypes explicitly
    df_target['Country'] = df_target['Country'].astype(str)
    df_target['Region'] = df_target['Region'].astype(str)

    int_columns = ['Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Rank_17']
    for col in int_columns:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    float_columns = [
        'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15',
        'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
        'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17', 'Family_17',
        'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
    ]
    for col in float_columns:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

    # Save the transformed dataframe to CSV
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
